rule: A Lean proof establishes a mathematical consequence of a definition. It is never evidence that APGI describes the brain. 'empirically-supported' requires a cited dataset and a pre-registered prediction ID.

claims.text: Raising θ cannot make ignition easier at fixed S.
The clamped update preserves the positivity floor θ_floor (0 AU by default).

The θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] AU is not an invariant of the clamped update for unrestricted targets; it is invariant when targets lie in the band and 0 ≤ g ≤ 1. Consistent with the Notation Appendix: θₜ may leave the band transiently.
a < 0 is necessary for cusp bistability (and hence hysteresis).
a < 0 and 4a³ + 27θ² < 0 together are sufficient for three distinct equilibria.
claims.note: Moved from tested to proved; the Hypothesis twin test_cusp_three_equilibria checks the float64 realisation.

claims.text: Forward-Euler relaxation stays in bounds when Δt ≤ τ.
APGI's hysteresis prediction (Innovation 4) holds in human data.
κ (ATP per bit of ignition-event information) has no canonical value; published sensitivity calculations span 3 × 10³ to 10⁹ ATP/bit.
claims.note: Replaces the draft claim 'κ ≈ 1,700, dimensionless overhead'. Uncalibrated by the corpus's own statement (Notation Appendix p22).

claims.text: The exact exponential decay (Math Spec Eq. 32) keeps θ inside any interval that contains θ and θ₀, for every step dt ≥ 0, with no step-size condition.
